$comment: Radio groups of the native toolkit (#882): the segmented choice (also the preset choice) and the swatch choice. Taken from the Settings of the time, which was the spec (ui/shell/styles/_settings.scss): button.settings-preset-btn and button.accent-circle-btn. The swatch rule went with the cyan-only picker removal (2026-11-12); the swatch numbers below are now carried by nk-widgets' swatch choice, which has no live use since that removal. Final values require owner live review.
Default applies to every dark/reduceTransparency variant; variants override whole fields like list.json. Exported once as choices in each components.json mode variant.

segmented.source: button.settings-preset-btn: padding 5px 14px, 1px border var(--veltrix-border), font-size $fse-small, radius $veltrix-radius-sm (components common.radius); selected = .veltrix-btn--primary, the accent with accent-fg text.

swatch.source: Former button.accent-circle-btn (removed with the cyan-only picker removal, 2026-11-12): min 30px, 3px border, selected = border and a 2px outer ring of --veltrix-text, hover border --veltrix-text-dim. Gap: space-2 between swatches (provisional). Numbers now carried by nk-widgets' swatch choice.
